de: Han Seong-sook fordert alle Regierungsbehörden auf, auf die Hitzewelle zu reagieren: „Überprüfen Sie die Schutz- und Sicherheitsregeln für die Schwachen.“ Premierminister Han Seong-sook leitet ein Treffen zur Überprüfung der Reaktionen auf Hitzewellen und Dürren, das am 31. letzten Monats im Seoul Situation Center des Central Disaster and Safety Situation Room im Seoul Government Complex in Jongno-gu, Seoul, stattfand. Yonhap News-Premierminister Han Seong-sook forderte die zuständigen Ministerien und Kommunalverwaltungen dringend auf, aktiv auf ihre Pflichten zu reagieren, da sich die Hitzewelle am 2. verschärfte und in einigen Regionen Besorgnis über Dürreschäden laut wurde. Das Ministerium für Gesundheit und Soziales wurde gebeten, auf gefährdete Menschen wie allein lebende ältere Menschen und Menschen, die in Einzelzimmern leben, zu reagieren.
title: 한성숙, 범부처 폭염대응 당부 “취약계층 보호·안전수칙 점검”
description: 한성숙 국무총리가 지난달 31일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사 중앙재난안전상황실 서울상황센터에서 열린 폭염ㆍ가뭄 대처사항 점검회의를 주재하고 있다. 연합뉴스한성숙 국무총리는 2일 폭염 상황이 심화하고 일부 지역에서는 가뭄 피해 우려도 제기됨에 따라 관계부처와 지방정부에 소관 업무에 대해 적극 대응할 것을 긴급 지시했다.보건복지부에는 독거노인·쪽방 거주민 등 취약···
en: Han Seong-sook requests all government agencies to respond to the heat wave, “Inspect the protection and safety rules for the vulnerable.” Prime Minister Han Seong-sook is presiding over a meeting to review responses to heat waves and droughts held at the Seoul Situation Center of the Central Disaster and Safety Situation Room at the Seoul Government Complex in Jongno-gu, Seoul on the 31st of last month. Yonhap News Prime Minister Han Seong-sook urgently ordered related ministries and local governments to actively respond to their duties as the heatwave situation worsened on the 2nd and concerns about drought damage were raised in some regions. The Ministry of Health and Welfare was asked to respond to vulnerable people such as the elderly living alone and people living in single rooms.
la: Han Seong-sook omnes administrationes imperii postulat ut undae calori respondeat, "Tutelam et salutem inspice regulas vulnerabiles." Primus minister Han Seong-sook praeest conventui ad responsiones recensendas ut fluctus aestus et siccitates in Centro Seoul Situationis Centralis calamitatis et Salutis conclave apud Seoul Imperium complexum in Jongno-gu, Seoul die 31 ultimi mensis tenuit. Yonhap Nuntii Primus minister Han Seong-sook instanter ordinavit ministeria cognata et administrationes locales ut suis officiis actuose responderet sicut condicio caloris die 2 ingravescebat et cura de siccitatis damno in nonnullis regionibus excitabantur. Ministerium Health et saluti rogabatur ut homines vulnerabiles responderent sicut senes soli viventes et homines in singulis conclavibus habitantes.

de: Der Miryang-Staudamm am Nakdong-Fluss und der Pyeongnim-Staudamm am Yeongsan-Fluss haben Dürreniveau erreicht. Da sich die Dürre in der südlichen Region verschlimmert, hat sich die Dürrestufe des Miryang-Staudamms in Yeongnam und des Pyeonglim-Staudamms in Honam erhöht. Das Ministerium für Klima, Energie und Umwelt gab an diesem Tag bekannt, dass der Miryang-Staudamm, ein Mehrzweckdamm in der Nakdong-Flussregion, ab Mitternacht des 2. in die Dürre-Alarmstufe eingetreten ist. Der Miryang-Staudamm in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, versorgt Yangsan-si, Miryang-si und Changnyeong-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do mit Wasser, wo es weiterhin zu extremen Hitzewellen kommt. Die Dürrestufen sind Besorgnis, Vorsicht, Warnung und ernst 4...

description: 남부지방 물 부족 ‘심화’남부지방 가뭄이 심화하면서 영남 밀양댐과 호남 평림댐의 가뭄 단계가 격상됐다.기후에너지환경부는 2일 0시를 기준으로 낙동강권역 다목적댐인 밀양댐이 가뭄 ‘경계’ 단계에 진입했다고 이날 밝혔다. 경남 밀양시에 있는 밀양댐은 극한 폭염이 이어진 경남 양산시, 밀양시, 창녕군 등에 물을 공급한다.가뭄 단계는 관심, 주의, 경계, 심각 4···
en: Miryang Dam on the Nakdong River and Pyeongnim Dam on the Yeongsan River raised to drought level. As the drought in the southern region worsens, the drought level of Miryang Dam in Yeongnam and Pyeonglim Dam in Honam has been raised. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment announced on this day that Miryang Dam, a multi-purpose dam in the Nakdong River region, has entered the drought 'alert' stage as of midnight on the 2nd. Miryang Dam, located in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, supplies water to Yangsan-si, Miryang-si, and Changnyeong-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do, where extreme heat waves have continued. The drought levels are concern, caution, warning, and serious 4...

Cum siccitas in regione meridionali ingravescit, in gradu siccitatis Miryang Dam in Yeongnam et Pyeonglim Dam in Honam evectus est. Miryang Dam, in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do sitam, Yangsan-si, Miryang-si, et Changnyeong-gun in Gyeongsangnam-do, aquam tribuit, ubi aestus nimii permanserunt. de: Hitzewelle, Dürre oder Waldbrand … die ganze Welt leidet unter einer Klimakrise. Am 30. letzten Monats (Ortszeit) zeigt der Fluss Lek bei Beusihem in den Niederlanden sein ausgetrocknetes Flussbett. Associated Press Yonhap News Aufgrund der schlimmsten Hitzewelle und Dürre in der Geschichte hat sich ein gewaltiges Feuer über das ausgetrocknete Gras und den Boden ausgebreitet und die ganze Welt getroffen, unabhängig von Kontinent oder Land. In einigen Ländern wurden Energieversorgungsanlagen wie Kernkraftwerke aufgrund der Dürre abgeschaltet und es gab Warnungen vor drohender Nahrungsmittelknappheit ...
title: 폭염, 가뭄, 아니면 산불···전 세계가 기후위기 몸살
description: 지난달 30일(현지시간) 네덜란드 베우시헴 인근 레크 강이 마른 강바닥을 드러내 보이고 있다. AP연합뉴스사상 최악의 폭염과 가뭄에 메마른 목초와 토양을 타고 일파만파 퍼진 초대형 화재가 대륙과 국가를 가리지 않고 전 세계를 강타하고 있다. 일부 국가에서는 가뭄 피해로 원자력 발전소 등 에너지 공급 시설이 중단됐고, 식량 부족이 목전에 왔다는 경고도 속출하···
en: Heat wave, drought, or forest fire...the whole world is suffering from a climate crisis. On the 30th of last month (local time), the Lek River near Beusihem, Netherlands, is showing its dry riverbed. Associated Press Yonhap News A massive fire has spread through the dried out grass and soil due to the worst heat wave and drought in history, hitting the entire world regardless of continent or country. In some countries, energy supply facilities such as nuclear power plants have been shut down due to drought, and there have been warnings that food shortages are imminent...
la: Calor fluctus, sitis, vel silva ignis... Totus mundus discrimine climatis laborat. Die 30 proximi mensis (loci temporis), Lek flumen prope Beusihem, Nederlandiam alveum suum siccum demonstrat. Consociata Press Yonhap News Ignis ingens per herbam et terram siccatam propter pessimum aestum fluctum et siccitatem in historia diffudit, totum mundum continentis vel reipublicae feriendo. In nonnullis regionibus, energiae facultates copiae ut nuclei plantae ob siccitatem clausae sunt, et monita sunt ut cibi inopias immineant.

de: Von extremen Hitzewellen bis hin zu Dürre … Yeongnam „Wassernotstand“. Pohang gräbt einen Brunnen und Cheongdo bereitet sich darauf vor, das Wasser abzusperren. „Das Dorf ist in Schwierigkeiten, weil es kein Wasser gibt. Es ist schon über 30 Jahre her, also müssen wir das beheben“, sagte Kim Gyu-bok (74), Dorfvorsteher, den wir am 2. in Hwadae-ri, Gigi-myeon, Buk-gu, Pohang, Gyeongsangbuk-do trafen, während wir den Staub von einem rostigen landwirtschaftlichen Brunnen (eine Art Brunnen zum Hochpumpen von Grundwasser) abschüttelten. Dieser Röhrenbrunnen, der vermutlich vor etwa 30 Jahren installiert wurde, wurde in der Vergangenheit zweimal bei schweren Dürren genutzt.
title: 극한 폭염에 가뭄까지…영남 ‘물 비상’
description: 포항은 우물 파고, 청도는 단수 준비“마을에 물이 없어 난리입니다. 30년도 넘은 건데 이거라도 고쳐봐야죠.”경북 포항 북구 기계면 화대리에서 지난 2일 만난 김규복 이장(74)이 녹슨 농업용수 관정(지하수를 끌어올리기 위한 일종의 우물)에 앉은 먼지를 털어내며 말했다. 30여년 전 설치한 것으로 추정되는 이 관정은 과거 극심한 가뭄 때 2번 정도 사용한 ···
en: From extreme heat waves to drought… Yeongnam ‘water emergency’. Pohang is digging a well, and Cheongdo is preparing to cut off water. “The village is in trouble because there is no water. It’s been over 30 years, so we need to fix this,” said Kim Gyu-bok (74), village head, whom we met on the 2nd in Hwadae-ri, Gigi-myeon, Buk-gu, Pohang, Gyeongsangbuk-do, while shaking off the dust from a rusty agricultural water well (a type of well for pumping up groundwater). This tubewell, which is believed to have been installed about 30 years ago, was used twice during severe droughts in the past.
la: Ab aestu nimio ad siccitatem…Yeongnam 'aqua emergency'. Pohang puteum fodit, et Cheongdo aquam abscindere parat. "Vicus laborat quod aqua non est. Iam per XXX annos sic hoc figere oportet", Kim Gyu-bok dixit (74), pagus caput, quem die 2 in Hwadae-ri, Gigi-myeon, Buk-gu, Pohang, Gyeongsangbuk-do, pulverem ex ferrugine aquae bene colendi (typum putei sudoris excutiendum) excutiens. Hoc tubewellum, quod abhinc circiter XXX annos institutum esse creditur, bis in gravibus siccitatibus praeteritis adhibitum est.

de: Während sich die Dürre in der südlichen Region verschärft, erreicht der Milyang-Staudamm am Nakdong-Fluss die „Vorsichtsstufe“ und der Pyeonglim-Staudamm am Yeongsan-Fluss die „Vorsichtsstufe“ für die Dürre. Am 29. des letzten Monats, während die Dürre in der Region Gyeongnam anhält, ist der Baekan-Stausee in Muan-myeon, Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, trocken. An diesem Tag betrug die Wasserversorgungsrate in diesem Stausee nur 1,2 %. Das Ministerium für Klima, Energie und Umwelt teilte mit, dass der Miryang-Staudamm, ein Mehrzweckdamm in der Nakdong-Flussregion, ab Mitternacht des 2. in Dürrewarnung geraten sei.

en: As the drought intensifies in the southern region, the Milyang Dam on the Nakdong River enters the ‘caution’ level and the Pyeonglim Dam on the Yeongsan River enters the drought ‘caution’ level. On the 29th of last month, as drought continues in the Gyeongnam region, Baekan Reservoir in Muan-myeon, Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, is dry. On this day, the water supply rate in this reservoir was only 1.2%. Miryang|Reporter Kwon Do-hyeon As the drought in the southern region intensified, the drought level of Miryang Dam in Yeongnam (located in Miryang-si, Gyeongsangnam-do) and Pyeonglim Dam in Honam (located in Jangseong-gun, Gwangju, Jeollanam-do) was raised. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment said that as of midnight on the 2nd, Miryang Dam, a multi-purpose dam in the Nakdong River region, was placed on drought alert.

Ministerium Clima, Energy et Environment dixerunt quasi mediae noctis die 2 , Miryang Dam, multi- rem in regione fluminis Nakdong positam in siccitate intentam esse.

en: 40 degree ‘extreme heat wave’ hits Seoul… The first severe heat wave warning in the metropolitan area. On the 3rd, when a heat wave warning was issued for most of the country, Yeouido as seen through a thermal infrared camera from Seoul Dal, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, is dyed red. Thermal imaging cameras display red when the temperature is high and blue when it is cold. General photos taken with the same composition as the thermal image were layered together. 2026.08.03 Reporter Su-bin Han 40 degrees The extreme heat wave is spreading to the metropolitan area. Gwangyang-si, Gwangju, Jeollanam-do...
la: 40 gradus Item calor extremus fluctum Seoul percusserit… Prima gravis caloris admonitio in area metropolitana. de: [1 Minute Gesundheit] Sorgen Sie während der Hitzewelle unbedingt für Ihre 6080-Gesundheit. [ZD Net Korea] Während die rekordverdächtige Hitzewelle anhält, sind Warnlichter hinsichtlich Gesundheitsrisiken angegangen. Insbesondere die Gesundheit von Menschen ab 60 Jahren oder Menschen mit bestehenden Erkrankungen ist stärker gefährdet und benötigt besondere Aufmerksamkeit. Erstens kann es sein, dass die Schmerzen bei versteckten Krankheiten stärker spürbar werden, wenn die Zeit, die man beim Gehen oder Stehen aufgrund von Reisen oder Gehen verbringt, länger als üblich ist und die Menge an Aktivität zunimmt. Dehydrierung kann bei älteren Menschen zu Veränderungen des Blutdrucks führen. In diesem Fall ist Vorsicht geboten, da die Belastung des Herz-Kreislauf-Systems zunehmen kann. Vor allem, wenn Sie chronische Grunderkrankungen wie Bluthochdruck oder Diabetes haben…

Especially if you have chronic underlying diseases such as high blood pressure or diabetes…

title: [공식발표] 역대급 폭염에 5~6일 프로야구 안 열린다…‘KBO리그 비상’ 6일 폭염 관련 긴급 실행위 개최
description: 폭염으로 경기가 취소된 4일 잠실구장의 모습. 연합뉴스전국적인 폭염 여파로 관중 건강이 위험한 상황까지 벌어지자 KBO가 이틀 동안 1,2군의 모든 경기를 취소하기로 했다.KBO는 5일 “6일 긴급 실행위원회를 개최하고 폭염 관련 종합 대책을 논의할 방침”이라며 “종합 대책이 수립될 때까지 오늘(5일)과 내일(6일) 열릴 예정이었던 KBO 리그와 퓨처스리그···
en: [Official announcement] Professional baseball will not be held for 5-6 days due to the unprecedented heat wave... ‘KBO League Emergency’ held on the 6th with an emergency action committee related to the heat wave. A view of Jamsil Stadium on the 4th, when the game was canceled due to a heat wave. Yonhap News As the aftermath of a nationwide heat wave raised a risk to the health of spectators, the KBO decided to cancel all games of the first and second teams for two days. The KBO said on the 5th, “We plan to hold an emergency executive committee meeting on the 6th to discuss comprehensive measures related to the heat wave,” and added, “The KBO League and Futures League, which were scheduled to be held today (5th) and tomorrow (6th), until comprehensive measures are established.”
la: [Denuntiatio officialis] baseball professio non tenebitur per 5-6 dies propter inauditum aestum fluctum... 'KBO League Emergency' die VI cum subitis actionis commissione ad aestum fluctum pertinente habita est. Prospectus Stadium Jamsil die 4 , cum ludus ob aestum fluctum abolitum est. Yonhap News Ut undae caloris nationalis reparata periculum ad spectatorum salutem excitavit, KBO omnes ludos primae et secundae iunctionis per duos dies rescindere constituit. KBO die 5. dixit, "Conventus exsecutivus subitis consilium habere in VI de remediis comprehensivis ad undam aestus pertinentibus", et addidit "The KBO League and Futures League, quae hodie (5th) et cras (6th) habitae erant, donec mensurae comprehensivae constituuntur."

de: [Redaktion] Die Arbeitsunterbrechung aufgrund von Hitzewellen, die lediglich eine Empfehlung darstellt, muss zwingend geändert werden. Innenarbeiter auf einer Baustelle der Korea Flooring Workers' Union stellen ihre Arbeit auf der Baustelle nach, während sie am 29. letzten Monats vor dem Seouler Arbeits- und Arbeitsamt eine Pressekonferenz abhalten, in der sie die Umsetzung von Hitzewellenmaßnahmen fordern. Reporter Su-bin Han Da die durch die Klimakrise verursachten Hitzewellen immer schlimmer werden, scheint die Zahl der Arbeitsunfälle aufgrund hitzebedingter Krankheiten im Sommer jedes Jahr zuzunehmen. In jüngster Zeit gab es eine Reihe von Fällen, in denen Arbeitnehmer aus gefährdeten Gruppen, wie z. B. Wanderarbeiter, bei der Arbeit in der sengenden Hitze starben ...
title: [사설]권고뿐인 폭염 작업중지, 강제력 있게 바꿔야
description: 한국마루노동조합 소속 건설현장 실내공사 노동자들이 지난달 29일 서울고용노동청 앞에서 폭염대책 시행 촉구 기자회견을 하면서 현장에서 일하는 모습을 재현하고 있다. 한수빈 기자기후위기로 인한 폭염이 갈수록 심각해지면서 여름철 온열질환 산업재해가 해마다 늘고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 최근 이주노동자 등 취약계층 노동자가 무더위 속에서 일하다 숨지는 일도 잇따르고···
en: [Editorial] The suspension of work due to heat waves, which is only a recommendation, must be changed compulsorily. Indoor workers at a construction site belonging to the Korea Flooring Workers' Union are reenacting their work at the site while holding a press conference in front of the Seoul Employment and Labor Office on the 29th of last month calling for the implementation of heat wave measures. Reporter Su-bin Han As heat waves caused by the climate crisis become more severe, the number of industrial accidents due to heat-related illnesses in summer appears to be increasing every year. Recently, there have been a series of cases of workers from vulnerable groups, such as migrant workers, dying while working in the scorching heat...
la: [Editorial] Suspensio operis ob aestus undarum, quae tantum commendatio est, necessario mutanda est. Opifices umbraticis in constructione situs Unionis operariorum Coreae Tabulatum rescindunt suum opus in situ dum collationem diurnariam tenentes ante officium Seoul Employment et Laboris die 29 mensis proximi vocantem ad exsequendam mensuras aestus fluctuantes. Notario Su-bin Han Sicut fluctus caloris causatur discriminis climatis graviores fiunt, numerus accidentium industrialium ob æstatem relatarum morborum aestate quotannis crescere videtur. Nuper series causarum operarum ex coetibus nudis factae sunt, ut advenae advenus, dum in aestu aestus operando moriebatur.

de:
Das Wunder der Insel Siru, das wir trotz der Hitzewelle erlebt haben, lässt uns das Herz weinen. Am 3. heizte die Kesselhitze von 37 Grad Celsius, die selbst das mit Wasserflaschen gefüllte Eiswasser schnell lauwarm werden ließ, die gesamte Stadt Danyang in der Provinz Nord-Chungcheong auf. Mitten im Sommer, wenn jedes Mal, wenn Sie Luft holen, die Hitze tief in Ihre Lungen strömt, ist der Zielort Ihrer Schritte die Hängebrücke der Insel Siru in Jeungdo-ri, Danyang-eup, Provinz Nord-Chungcheong. ​

Als ich zur neu gebauten Shiruseom-Hängebrücke ging, einer berühmten Sehenswürdigkeit in Danyang, glitzerten die ruhigen Wellen des Namhangang-Flusses unter der violetten Stahlkonstruktion im Sonnenlicht. Der Blick auf den Fluss unter der glühenden Sonne ist unendlich friedlich ...
title: 폭염 뚫고 만난 시루섬의 기적, 가슴을 울립니다
description:
지난 3일, 수통을 가득 채운 얼음물마저 금세 미지근해지는 섭씨 37도의 가마솥 더위가 충북 단양 전체를 뜨겁게 달구고 있었다. 숨을 들이 쉴 때마다 뜨거운 열기가 폐부 깊숙이 밀려 드는 한여름, 발걸음이 향한 곳은 충북 단양읍 증도리에 위치한 시루섬 출렁다리였다. ​

단양의 명물로 새로이 놓인 시루섬 출렁다리로 걸어가자, 보랏빛 철골 구조물 아래로 남한강의 잔잔한 물결이 햇살을 받아 반짝였다. 찌는 듯한 뙤약볕 아래서 바라보는 강 풍경은 하염 없이 평화롭고…
en:
The miracle of Siru Island that we encountered despite the heat wave makes our hearts cry. On the 3rd, the cauldron heat of 37 degrees Celsius, which made even the ice water filled with water bottles quickly become lukewarm, was heating up the entire city of Danyang, North Chungcheong Province. In the middle of summer, when every time you take a breath, the heat rushes deep into your lungs, the place where your steps are headed is Siru Island Suspension Bridge, located in Jeungdo-ri, Danyang-eup, North Chungcheong Province. ​

As I walked to the newly built Shiruseom Suspension Bridge, a famous attraction in Danyang, the calm waves of the Namhangang River sparkled under the purple steel structure in the sunlight. The view of the river under the sweltering sun is endlessly peaceful...
la:
Miraculum Siru Islandiae quod offendimus, obstante aestu fluctuanti corda nostra clamare facit. Die 3, aeni calor 37 graduum Celsius, quae aqua etiam glacie repleta utribus aqua cito tepefacta est, totam civitatem Danyang, provinciae septentrionalis Chungcheong, calefaciebat. Medio aestatis, quotiens respiras, aestus in pulmones tuos profunde ruit, locus quo gressus tenduntur est Pons Siru Island Suspensio, sita in Jeungdo-ri, Danyang-eup, Provincia Septentrionalis Chungcheong. ​

Sicut ambulabam ad nuper aedificatum Shiruseom Suspensionis pontem, nobilis attractio in Danyang, tranquillitas fluminis Namhangang scintillabat sub purpureo ferro structura in solis. Prospectus fluminis sub sole tranquillus est sine fine.

de:
Aufgrund der extremen Hitzewelle gehen die Menschen drinnen statt ins Freie...Tmap „Verstärkte Besuche in Einkaufszentren und kulturellen Einrichtungen.“ T-Karte, Analyse der landesweiten Anzahl wichtiger Zielorteinstellungen vom 27. Juli bis 2. August
Da Besuche in Innenräumen von Einkaufszentren und Kultureinrichtungen zunehmen und Fahrten zu Freizeiteinrichtungen im Freien zurückgehen, gab T Map Mobility am 5. bekannt, dass durch den Vergleich der Anzahl der Zieleinstellungen an wichtigen Reisezielen im ganzen Land während der Hitzewelle mit dem gleichen Zeitraum des Vorjahres die Einkaufskategorie um 5,2 % gestiegen ist, während die Reise- und Freizeitkategorie um 16,5 % zurückgegangen ist. Es wird analysiert, dass die extreme Hitzewelle von über 40 Grad sogar die Wahl der Sommerferienorte verändert hat. Der Zeitraum ist vom 27. Juli bis 2. August...
title: 극한 폭염에 야외 대신 실내로⋯티맵 "쇼핑몰·문화시설 등 방문 증가"
description:
티맵, 지난 7월 27일부터 8월 2일까지 전국 주요 방문지 목적지 설정 건수 분석
쇼핑몰·문화시설 등 실내 방문은 늘고, 야외 레저시설 이동은 줄어 티맵모빌리티는 폭염 기간 전국 주요 방문지의 목적지 설정 건수를 전년 동기와 비교한 결과 쇼핑 카테고리는 5.2% 증가한 반면 여행·레저 카테고리는 16.5% 감소했다고 5일 밝혔다. 40도를 넘나드는 극한 폭염이 피서지 선택까지 바꾼 것으로 분석된다. 기간은 7월 27일부터 8월 2일…
en:
Due to the extreme heat wave, people go indoors instead of outdoors...Tmap "Increased visits to shopping malls and cultural facilities." T Map, analysis of the number of major destination destination settings nationwide from July 27th to August 2nd
As indoor visits to shopping malls and cultural facilities increase, and trips to outdoor leisure facilities decrease, T Map Mobility announced on the 5th that as a result of comparing the number of destination settings at major destinations across the country during the heat wave with the same period last year, the shopping category increased by 5.2%, while the travel and leisure category decreased by 16.5%. It is analyzed that the extreme heat wave, which exceeds 40 degrees, has even changed the choice of summer resorts. The period is from July 27th to August 2nd...
la:
Ob nimiam aestum fluctum, homines domesticas pro foris procedunt...Tmap "Adcreverunt visitationes ad mercaturas et facultates culturales". T Tabula, analysis numeri destinationis maioris destinationis regionum nationum a die 27 Iulii ad diem 2 Augusti
Cum tabernacula visitationes ad mercaturas et facultates culturales augeantur, et itinera ad otium ocii facilities diminuantur, T Map Mobilitatem denuntiavit in 5th quod ex comparatione numeri destinationum occasus in majoribus destinationibus per regionem in aestu fluctu eodem tempore proximo anno, categoria shopping 5.2% augetur, dum categoria peregrinationis et otii minuitur 16.5%. Enucleatur quod fluctus extremus calor, qui 40 gradus excedit, etiam mutatur electio aestatis frequentat. Tempus est a die 27 Iulii ad diem 2 Augusti.

de: Tropische Nacht in Gwangju, Jeonnam, 16,6 Tage „höchste aller Zeiten“... Ausbreitung der Schäden, einschließlich hitzebedingter Krankheiten und Todesfälle bei Nutztieren. Am 30. Juli ziehen Bürger in Yongbong-dong, Buk-gu, Gwangju Unified Special City, Jeollanam-do, umher und tragen Sonnenschirme, um das starke Sonnenlicht abzuschirmen. Yonhap News Im Juli dieses Jahres wurde festgestellt, dass die Zahl der Tropennächte in Gwangju, Jeollanam-do, die höchste seit meteorologischen Beobachtungen war. Da die Hitze Tag und Nacht anhält, erkranken an einem Tag 18 Menschen an hitzebedingten Krankheiten, und die Schäden durch die Hitzewelle weiten sich aus, wobei Nutztiere und Zuchtfische nacheinander sterben. Nach Angaben der regionalen Meteorologischen Verwaltung von Gwangju am 5....
title: 전남광주 열대야 16.6일 ‘역대 최다’···온열질환·가축 폐사 등 피해 확산
description: 지난 7월 30일 전남광주통합특별시 북구 용봉동에서 시민들이 강렬한 햇빛을 가리는 양산을 쓰고 이동하고 있다. 연합뉴스올해 7월 전남광주지역 열대야 일수가 기상 관측 이래 가장 많았던 것으로 나타났다. 밤낮없이 무더위가 계속되면서 온열질환자가 하루에만 18명 발생하고, 가축과 양식어류 폐사도 잇따르는 등 폭염 피해가 확산하고 있다.5일 광주지방기상청에 따르···
en: Tropical night in Gwangju, Jeonnam, 16.6 days ‘highest ever’... Spread of damage including heat-related illnesses and livestock deaths. On July 30, citizens are moving around in Yongbong-dong, Buk-gu, Gwangju Unified Special City, Jeollanam-do, wearing parasols to block the strong sunlight. Yonhap News In July of this year, the number of tropical nights in Gwangju, Jeollanam-do was found to be the highest since meteorological observations were made. As the heat continues day and night, 18 people are suffering from heat-related illnesses in one day, and the damage from the heat wave is spreading, with livestock and farmed fish dying one after another. According to the Gwangju Regional Meteorological Administration on the 5th...
la: Nox tropica in Gwangju, Jeonnam, 16.6 dies 'supremae semper'... Divulgatio damni incluso morbos caloris relatos et mortes iumentorum. Die 30 mensis Iulii circumeunt cives Yongbong-dong, Buk-gu, Gwangju Praecipua Civitas Unita, Jeollanam-do, parasolas gerentes ut solis fortibus obstet. Yonhap Nuntii Mense Iulio huius anni, numerus noctium tropicarum in Gwangju, Jeollanam-do inventa est summa cum observationibus meteorologicis factae sunt. Sicut calor instat die ac nocte, 18 homines in una die laborantes morbos æstu- latos, et noxa aestus diffunditur, cum pecoribus et piscibus inter se morientibus colitur. Secundum Gwangju Administration Meteorologicum Regionalis die 5th...

de: Ryu Je-myeong, Zweiter Vizeminister für Wissenschaft und IKT, besucht das Postamt von Cheongju, um die Reaktion auf die Hitzewelle zu überprüfen. „Nutzen Sie das Recht, die Arbeit zum richtigen Zeitpunkt auszusetzen, beispielsweise für Postangestellte und bei Warnungen vor schwerer Hitzewelle.“ Ryu Je-myeong, Zweiter Vizeminister für Wissenschaft und IKT, besuchte am 5. das Postamt Cheongju, um Postangestellte zur Postzustellstelle zu begleiten und die Sicherheitsmanagementmaßnahmen im Sommer zu überprüfen. An diesem Tag überbrachte Vizeminister Ryu mit einem Postboten die Post und ermutigte die Mitarbeiter, die inmitten einer rekordverdächtigen Hitzewelle vor Ort arbeiteten.
title: 류제명 과기정통부 2차관, 청주우체국 찾아 폭염 대응 점검
description: "집배원, 폭염중대경보 등 적기 업무정지권 사용해야" 당부 류제명 과학기술정보통신부 제2차관이 5일 청주우체국을 찾아 집배원들의 우편물 배달 현장에 동행하고 여름철 안전관리 대책을 점검했다. 류 차관은 이날 집배원과 함께 우편물을 배달하며 기록적인 폭염 속에서 현장 업무를 수행하고 있는 직원들을 격려했다.
en: Ryu Je-myeong, Second Vice Minister of Science and ICT, visits Cheongju Post Office to inspect response to heat wave. "Use right to suspend work at the right time, such as for postal workers and severe heat wave warnings." Ryu Je-myeong, Second Vice Minister of Science and ICT, visited the Cheongju Post Office on the 5th to accompany postal workers to the mail delivery site and inspect safety management measures in the summer. On this day, Vice Minister Ryu delivered mail with a postman and encouraged employees who were working in the field amid a record-breaking heat wave.
la: Ryu Je-myeong, secundus vice minister scientiae et ICT, visitat Cheongju Post Office ut inspiciat responsionem ad undam calefacere. Utere iure suspendendi laborem tempore opportuno, ut ad operarios tabellarios et graves aestus fluctus admonitiones. Ryu Je-myeong, Secundus Vice Minister Scientiae et ICT, Cheongju Post Officium visitavit die 5. ut operarios tabellarios comitaretur ad locum partus mail et mensuras aestivae administrationis securitatis inspiceret. Hac die, Vice minister Ryu epistulas tradidit cum TABELLARIO et adhortatus administros qui in agro operabantur inter fluctus caloris recordum praevaricationis.

de:
Umweltverbände fordern die Provinz Nord-Chungcheong auf, Hitzewellenmaßnahmen zu ergreifen, da der erste Todesfall aufgrund einer hitzebedingten Krankheit auftritt. Da in diesem Jahr in der Provinz Nord-Chungcheong der erste Todesfall durch hitzebedingte Krankheiten zu verzeichnen war, forderte die Umweltbewegungsföderation Cheongju-Chungbuk die Provinz Nord-Chungcheong dazu auf, eine grundlegende Politik zur Reaktion auf die Klimakrise festzulegen.

In der Provinz Nord-Chungcheong ereignete sich am 4. der erste Todesfall aufgrund einer hitzebedingten Erkrankung. Am 4. gegen 10 Uhr morgens brach Herr A, ein Mann in den Sechzigern, beim Versprühen von Pestiziden in Wonnam-myeon, Eumseong-gun, zusammen. Herr A. wurde mit Herzstillstand ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert, verstarb jedoch schließlich. Die Gesundheitsbehörden stellten fest, dass die Todesursache ein Hitzschlag war.

Am 4. wurde die Zahl der Menschen mit hitzebedingten Erkrankungen auf 103 gezählt. Nach Typ litten 74 Menschen unter Hitzeerschöpfung, Hitzschlag...
title: 첫 온열질환 사망자 발생에 환경단체, 충북도에 폭염 대책 촉구
description:
충북에서 올해 첫 온열질환 사망자가 발생한 가운데 청주충북환경운동연합이 충북도에 근본적인 기후위기 대응 정책 수립을 촉구하고 나섰다.

충북에서는 지난 4일 첫 온열질환 사망자가 발생했다. 지난 4일 오전 10시 경 음성군 원남면에서 농약을 살포하던 60대 남성 A씨가 쓰러졌다. A씨는 심정지 상태로 병원으로 이송됐으나 결국 숨졌다. 보건당국은 사망 원인을 열사병으로 판단했다.

4일 현재 온열질환자는 103명으로 집계됐다. 유형별로는 열탈진 74명, 열사병 …
en:
Environmental groups urge North Chungcheong Province to take heat wave measures as the first death from heat-related illness occurs. With the first death from heat-related diseases occurring in North Chungcheong Province this year, the Cheongju-Chungbuk Environmental Movement Federation urged North Chungcheong Province to establish a fundamental policy to respond to the climate crisis.

In North Chungcheong Province, the first death due to heat-related illness occurred on the 4th. At around 10 a.m. on the 4th, Mr. A, a man in his 60s, collapsed while spraying pesticides in Wonnam-myeon, Eumseong-gun. Mr. A was taken to the hospital in cardiac arrest, but eventually died. Health authorities determined that the cause of death was heat stroke.

As of the 4th, the number of people with heat-related illnesses was counted at 103. By type, 74 people suffered from heat exhaustion, heat stroke...
la:
Circuli ambitus Environmentales Chungcheong Septentrionales Provinciam hortantur ut mensuras fluctuantes calefaciat ut prima mors ex morbo actis caloris fiat. Cum prima morte ex morborum calorum actis in Provincia Chungcheong Septentrionali hoc anno occurrentibus, Foederatio Cheongju-Chungbuk Motus Environmentalis Motus Chungcheong Septentrionalis Provinciam Chungcheong hortatus est ut praecipuum consilium crisi climatis responderet.

In provincia Septentrionali Chungcheong prima mors ob morbum actis caloris die 4 factum est. Circa X a.m. quarto, Dominus A, vir in 60s, dum pesticidas in Wonnam-myeon, Eumseong-gun, spargit. Dominus A ad valetudinarium deprehensus cardiacis captus est, sed tandem mortuus est. Auctoritates sanitatis statuerunt causam ictui caloris esse mortem.

Sicut de 4th, numerus hominum cum morbis calidis relatis adnumeratus est 103. Typus, 74 homines lassitudines calorum, plaga caloris laborabant.

de: [Card News] Hitzewellen sind auch eine Krise für das Land! [GD Net Korea] Hallo, hier ist Reporter AMEET. Jeder spürt heutzutage das drückend heiße Wetter, oder? Diese Hitzewelle war so heftig, dass die Temperatur in Yangsan, Gyeongsangnam-do, auf satte 42 Grad anstieg und zum ersten Mal in der Geschichte die höchste Hitzewellewarnung ausgegeben wurde. Dies ist eine Situation, die zu gefährlich ist, als dass man sie dem Einzelnen überlassen könnte, aber tatsächlich waren die Meinungen der Experten eindeutig. de:
Warum waren nur Gyeongbuk und Gyeongnam besonders heiß? In diesem Sommer erlebt Südkorea eine rekordverdächtige Hitzewelle. Unter ihnen erschienen Gyeongbuk und Gyeongnam jeden Tag als die heißesten Regionen des Landes in den Nachrichten. Zufälligerweise ist dieses Gebiet auch der Ort, an dem in den letzten Jahren die größten Waldbrandschäden zu verzeichnen waren. Ist das nur ein Zufall? Oder gibt es einen Zusammenhang, den wir noch nicht verstehen?

Diese Frage wurde noch größer, als ich die beiden Karten nebeneinander platzierte. Eine davon ist eine Karte der landesweiten Anzahl von Hitzewellentagen nach Stadt, Kreis und Kreis Ende Juli 2026, die andere ist eine Karte der Waldbrände nach Stadt, Kreis und Kreis in den letzten 10 Jahren …
title: 왜 경북과 경남만 유난히 더 뜨거웠을까
description:
올여름 대한민국은 기록적인 폭염을 겪고 있다. 그 가운데서도 경북과 경남은 연일 전국에서 가장 뜨거운 지역으로 뉴스에 등장했다. 공교롭게도 이 지역은 최근 몇 년 사이 가장 큰 산불 피해를 경험한 곳이기도 하다. 이것은 단순한 우연일까? 아니면 우리가 아직 이해하지 못한 어떤 연결고리가 있는 것일까?

이 의문은 두 장의 지도를 나란히 놓는 순간 더욱 커졌다. 하나는 2026년 7월 말 전국 시군구별 폭염일수 지도이고, 다른 하나는 최근 10년간 시군구별 산불…
en:
Why were only Gyeongbuk and Gyeongnam particularly hot? This summer, South Korea is experiencing a record-breaking heat wave. Among them, Gyeongbuk and Gyeongnam appeared in the news every day as the hottest regions in the country. Coincidentally, this area is also the place that has experienced the greatest forest fire damage in recent years. Is this just a coincidence? Or is there some connection we don't yet understand?

This question grew even bigger the moment I placed the two maps side by side. One is a map of the number of heat wave days by city, county, and district nationwide at the end of July 2026, and the other is a map of forest fires by city, county, and district over the past 10 years...
la:
Cur solum Gyeongbuk et Gyeongnam praecipue calent? Hac aestate, Corea Meridiana aestus fluctuantis recorda-fractionis experitur. Inter quos Gyeongbuk et Gyeongnam in nuntio quotidie apparuerunt sicut calidissimae regiones in regione. Coincidenter, haec regio etiam locus est, qui maximum damnum incendiis silvestribus proximis annis expertus est. Hoccine tantum fortuitum? An estne aliquis nexus nondum intelligimus?

Haec quaestio etiam maior crevit momento duas tabulas iuxta posui. Una est tabula numeri aestus undarum dierum ab urbe, comitatu, et regione nationum exeunte mense Iulio 2026, et alia est tabula incendiorum silvarum ab urbe, comitatu, et districtu per X annos praeteriti.
